name: Tajny pomest'ja Berrouzov
source:
Scooby, Shaggy and their friends arrive at the mysterious Burroughs Manor to investigate the activities of a strange ghost who is terrifying the residents of this ancient house. It would seem to be a typical adventure plot for "Mystery Inc.". However, this time everything will be different...
